snippet.title: PACS - Post Apocalypse Courier Service - Playtest Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: In Post Apocalypse Courier Service, the world has ended, but the need for deliveries remains. Team up with up to three friends to navigate treacherous environments, scavenge for vehicle upgrades, and grow a courier service that fulfills the apocalyptic miracle of a package delivered on time. Customize your trucks, repair them, and face the challenges of delivering goods across desolate wastelands and deserted cities. Developed by Studio 316, this co-op delivery simulator offers a unique blend of survival and driving mechanics.
